filter: SOFT/HARD, 88 < lap seconds < 104, exclude lap 1, pit-out, stint first and last laps
limitations: Exploratory fit on this race, not prospective validation.
Age and race-lap effects are associations; lap trend is not a measured fuel effect.
Pit loss is a user-defined counterfactual parameter, not pit-lane duration.
Only S-H and S-H-S plans, no traffic, DNF or safety-car model.
Predicted stint ages can exceed observed support.
method: Médias a posteriori do modelo bayesiano hierárquico (race_strategy/pace.py); ver strategy-bayes.json
